cards.card_text: Jesus' followers have been praying together in Jerusalem (Acts 1:14), and now the day of Pentecost comes and they're all together in one place.
cards.verse_text: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
cards.snippet: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

cards.card_text: To reach Jerusalem by Pentecost To reach Rome before winter To reach Antioch by Passover
cards.verse_text: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
cards.snippet: …in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.

cards.card_text: But Corinth will have to wait a little: Paul is staying in Ephesus until Pentecost.
cards.verse_text: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost, because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
cards.snippet: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost, because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even…
